desc: Built for shooters who demand precision, portability, and versatility in one lightweight platform, the Fierce Reaper H-TAC 2.0 bridges the gap between a precision long-range rifle and a packable backcountry hunting rifle. A folding aluminum chassis paired with a C3 carbon fiber stock and barrel keeps the H-TAC 2.0 starting at just 6.5 lbs — with the feel and adjustability of a modern tactical chassis platform.
